Name: Dynamic Splitscreen
Author: IIIHessonIII
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Dynamic Splitscreen[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Renegade Ops-style dynamic splitscreen for Stardew Valley local co-op[/i][/size]
[b]Version 0.2.1[/b] | Author: [b]IIIHessonIII[/b]

[line]

[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]
Tired of being locked into a cramped, static 50/50 vertical or horizontal splitscreen when playing Stardew Valley locally with a friend or partner?

[b]Dynamic Splitscreen[/b] replaces the static split with an intelligent, dynamic camera system inspired by [i]Renegade Ops[/i]:


[table][tr][th]Feature[/th]
[th]How It Works[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Unified Merged Camera[/b][/td]
[td]When you and your co-op partner are near each other (< 8 tiles), you share a single, full-screen camera view centered between both farmers.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Smooth Dynamic Zoom[/b][/td]
[td]As you move apart, the camera smoothly zooms out to keep both of you on-screen without splitting prematurely.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Angled Voronoi Split[/b][/td]
[td]When you wander far apart (> 21 tiles), the screen seamlessly divides along a crisp angled divider line perpendicular to the vector between you.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Smooth Map & Fade Transitions[/b][/td]
[td]Entering a different location smoothly eases (<= 90°) into a vertical Left/Right split; re-entering the same map eases the Voronoi divider back into place; fade-to-black transitions mask cleanly to each player's Voronoi half-plane.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Unified Dual HUD & Menus[/b][/td]
[td]Both players' toolbars are visible with energy/health bars docked to the outside edges, a single shared top-right clock, and un-dimmed side-by-side menus with working P1/P2 mouse & controller input and tooltips.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Color-Coded P2 Indicators & Cursor[/b][/td]
[td]Distinct cyan controller cursor for Player 2 plus unified-view world and HUD indicators (cabin/shared mailboxes, buffs, HUD alerts, quest pulse, offscreen indicator) coded warm gold (P1) vs. cyan (P2) with zero text clutter.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[table][tr][th]Component[/th]
[th]Minimum Version / Setup[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Stardew Valley[/b][/td]
[td]1.6.0 or newer[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]SMAPI[/b][/td]
[td]4.0.0 or newer[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Controllers[/b][/td]

[/tr]

[line]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[table][tr][th]Step[/th]
[th]Action[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]1[/b][/td]
[td]Ensure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed and working.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]2[/b][/td]
[td]Download the release archive: [b]DynamicSplitscreen-v0.2.1.zip[/b].[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]3[/b][/td]
[td]Extract the zip archive and place the [font=Courier New]DynamicSplitscreen[/font] folder directly into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] directory.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]4[/b][/td]
[td]Launch the game via SMAPI ([font=Courier New]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/font]).[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]5[/b][/td]
[td]Load your farm, press [b]Esc[/b] / [b]Start[/b] -> [b]Options[/b] -> [b]Multiplayer[/b] -> [b]Start Local Co-op[/b], and join Player 2![/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[line]

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
A [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file will be automatically generated in the mod folder after launching the game for the first time. You can customize camera behavior to your liking:


[table][tr][th]Setting[/th]
[th]Default[/th]
[th]Description[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]MaxZoom[/font][/td]
[td]1.0[/td]
[td]Camera zoom level when players are close together[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]MinZoom[/font][/td]
[td]0.75[/td]
[td]Maximum zoom-out before splitting[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]SplitZoom[/font][/td]
[td]0.90[/td]
[td]Zoom level applied to each player's split viewport[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]ZoomStartDist[/font][/td]
[td]512.0[/td]
[td]Pixel distance (~8 tiles) where camera begins zooming out[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]SplitEnterDist[/font][/td]
[td]1344.0[/td]
[td]Pixel distance (~21 tiles) where screen splits into two half-planes[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]SplitExitDist[/font][/td]
[td]1120.0[/td]
[td]Pixel distance (~17.5 tiles) where screen merges back (hysteresis band)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]CameraEaseRate[/font][/td]
[td]4.5[/td]
[td]Smoothing rate for camera motion and zoom transitions[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]DividerWidthPx[/font][/td]
[td]3.0[/td]
[td]Pixel width of the dividing line between split screens[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
